title: Muay Thai.wav by RTB45

sourceDescription: Muay Thai or kickboxing, Thailand's national sport. This recording made at Ratchadamnoen Boxing Stadium in Bangkok gives a sense of the crowd's wild calls at each kick landed as well as the frenetic vocals of the placing of bets, strangely at its most intense after the third round of five.
